subject: Cloud procurement staging & marketplace readiness — Strata Health
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@stratahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud procurement staging & marketplace readiness — Strata Health

Thanks for the time today, Samira — quick recap and a few specific questions so we can coordinate with your procurement/finance teams. High-level: Strata wants to evaluate Redwood behind an initial pilot (non-prod inference for a customer support feature) and is leaning toward a marketplace route if it shortens procurement friction.

Call notes (short):
- Pilot: 30–60 day, ~1M tokens/month; conservative usage expected.
- Main ask: understand commercial path (AWS Marketplace private offer vs. PO/invoice vs. corporate card for pilot).
- Compliance asks: SOC 2 summary, DPA, and vendor onboarding form.

Questions / asks for procurement readiness:
1) Do you prefer AWS Marketplace (Private Offer) if we can structure it to meet Strata's invoice and GL needs, or will finance insist on a PO to Redwood directly?
2) Who is the procurement/contact that handles vendor onboarding and PO issuance (name + email)?
3) Timeline: how long for a standard PO once paperwork is in?
4) Any other vendor forms we should expect (tax forms, W-9 equivalents, vendor portal)?

I've attached a short "Marketplace Readiness" checklist (stub) — it lists the typical artifacts and the two commercial routes (Marketplace private offer vs. vendor invoice/PO). If Marketplace is preferred we can scope a Private Offer (Redwood -> Strata) and show exactly what the invoice cadence looks like. If PO is required, we can accept a PO and invoice monthly. For pilots under $25k we can also accept corporate card to get started faster.

Next steps I propose:
- You introduce your procurement lead (Miguel or procurement@) so Marissa can drop the PO template and the vendor onboarding packet.
- If Marketplace is preferred, confirm and we'll have Karthik kick off the private-offer setup and share the merchant/offer flow.

Attachments: Strata_Marketplace_Readiness_Checklist.xlsx (outline); Redwood SOC2 summary (high level).

Thanks — I can be flexible on timelines this week for a quick procurement intro call.

—
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@stratahealth.com>

Subject: Re: Cloud procurement staging & marketplace readiness — Strata Health

Aditya — thanks for the concise recap. Good summary; couple answers below.

1) Preference: AWS Marketplace would be ideal for speed, but our finance team historically prefers POs for anything above $10k. If you can confirm that the Private Offer will still allow us to get a formal invoice and a Vendor/GL mapping that finance accepts, Marketplace could win.

2) Procurement contact: Miguel Torres (miguel.t@stratahealth.com) — he handles vendor onboarding and can run our standard vendor questionnaire. Procurement inbox: procurement@stratahealth.com.

3) Timeline: PO approvals typically take 7–10 business days once the vendor packet is complete; for expedited purchases (leadership sign-off) it can be 2–3 days. Marketplace private offers historically can be faster but require our procurement team to sign off on the vendor details and billing cadence.

4) Required docs: our procurement team will want SOC 2 Type 2 summary, DPA, W-9 (or equivalent tax cert), and the standard vendor onboarding questionnaire — I'll attach the questionnaire in a follow-up.

We are happy to try Marketplace if you can make the private-offer flow look like a normal invoice in our AP system. For the pilot, we could also do a 30-day pilot on card if Redwood can accept card and then convert to PO/Marketplace for production.

Pls loop Miguel in and Marissa — I'll have Miguel share our vendor questionnaire and any vendor portal steps.

Subject: Re: Cloud procurement staging & marketplace readiness — Strata Health

Thanks Samira — looping Miguel in (thanks in advance). Quick answers and proposed MAP so we can move.

Short answers:
- Marketplace: Redwood supports AWS Marketplace Private Offers. We can configure the offer so your AP sees an invoice-like record; we will confirm the line-item & GL mapping details during onboarding. Karthik will own the technical setup for the private offer.
- PO path: We can accept a PO and invoice monthly (Net 30 default) — Marissa will help with invoicing cadence and commercial paperwork.
- Card: for an initial 30-day pilot under $25k we can accept corporate card to accelerate start; later convert to PO/Marketplace for sustained usage.
- Compliance: attached our SOC2 summary and a PO template. We also provide a DPA and can complete your vendor questionnaire.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) Procurement intro & vendor packet (Owner: Miguel / Marissa) — deliverable: filled questionnaire + vendor portal entry. Target: 2–5 business days.
2) Billing route decision (Owner: Miguel / Strata finance + Redwood) — Marketplace private offer vs PO. Target: decide within 3 business days.
3) Private Offer setup or PO creation (Owner: Karthik / Marissa) — provide merchant details or accept PO number. Target: 3–7 business days after decision.
4) Pilot kickoff (Owner: Aditya) — provisioning, test prompts, telemetry access. Target: within 48 hours of billing setup.

Next asks from our side to move quickly:
- Miguel / procurement: please share your vendor questionnaire and the expected PO template or sample.
- Confirm whether finance will accept a Marketplace Private Offer as an acceptable billing record once merchant/line-item mapping is provided.
- Preferred billing email and AP contact for invoices.

Attachments: PO_Template.pdf; Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf; Strata_Marketplace_Readiness_Checklist.xlsx (previous).

If it's OK I'll schedule a 30-minute intro with Miguel + Marissa + Karthik later today or tomorrow to get the packet over the line.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a pilot.

—
Aditya Rao

I'll own the PO/commercial side and coordinate with Miguel — happy to lead the exchange of the vendor packet and invoice cadence. Quick checklist I will action: 
- Send completed PO template once Miguel confirms billing info (owner: Marissa; ETA: today).
- Provide Redwood's vendor forms and W-9 equivalent; we'll also attach our standard DPA.
- Confirm invoicing cadence (monthly Net30 by default) and provide invoice remit address and billing email.
- For Marketplace private offer: Karthik, we'll need the merchant account details and the expected invoice line items so Strata's AP can map them. Can you prepare a 1-page summary for their AP?

I'll set up a 20-minute procurement triage call (Marissa + Karthik + Miguel) for tomorrow morning to move the packet. Aditya, please include the pilot kickoff doc so we can align the activation and card fallback if needed.
